syllabus_extract: Introduction to emergency locater Transmitter. Basic principle of ELT.
specific_objectives: 18.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to describe the basic theory of operation of surveillance system of an aircraft.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of ELT theory diagrams and signal propagation concepts from IB and L & Ds under instructor supervision.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an ELT?
In which frequency bands do ELTs operate?
What are the three types of ELT activation methods?

development.content:
Definition and purpose of ELT
Activation methods overview
Frequency bands used
Signal transmission basics

Basic principle of operation
UHF vs 406 MHz differences
Satellite detection mechanism
Signal modulation techniques

Survival locator beacon theory
Distress signal generation
Automatic vs manual activation
Battery life and maintenance basics

summary_questions: Explain the basic theory of operation for an ELT surveillance system.
Describe how a satellite detects an ELT distress signal.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the differences between UHF and 406 MHz ELT systems to be discussed in LP 05.
